name: Variable Equality Constraint Selection
description: Instead of "groups" and "merging", frame the problem as selecting a subset of equality constraints to enforce on a set of variables, such that a specific subset of target variables are forced to be equal to each other. This hides the graph/tree nature of the problem, making it look like a system of equations or a logical inference problem, disrupting the model's ability to pattern-match to Steiner Tree.
